gap: No result ChatGPT got states that BLUETTI's own 'Apex 300+B300K+2*200W' bundle costs $3,499, which is $102 more than putting the same store's Apex 300 + B300K ($2,599) and its 2×200W SP200L pack ($798) in one cart for $3,397. In this store the cheaper way to buy the set is the separate items, not the bundle.
standout_why: Both saved ChatGPT chats (2026-11-14, gpt-6) list no search results and no cited pages, so there was no rival page to compare against. ChatGPT's own answer gives size ranges and a rough budget of $2,500–$5,500. It names no store, no cart and no bundle-versus-separate price, and it does not say that a 120 V-only inverter can't run 240 V loads. A cart fact like this changes which link to use but not which parts go in the set, so it scores 2 rather than 3.
kit_items: Solar array: Sun Gold Power 6 × 200 W monocrystalline panels (1.2 kW), included in the SGM-5K5E kit. This is within ChatGPT's 800–1,500 W range for a weekend cabin.

Inverter-charger with built-in MPPT: Sun Gold Power 5000W 48V Solar Charger Inverter. The store says it takes up to 5,500 W and 500 V of PV, and has an RS485 port for talking to the battery's management system.
Battery: Sun Gold Power SG48100P 51.2 V 100 Ah LiFePO4 server-rack battery (5.12 kWh, UL1973/UL9540A). It is 48 V class, so it matches the inverter.
Protection and wiring: 160 A DC breaker, 25 A PV breaker, 4 AWG breaker-to-inverter cable, 50 ft PV extension cables and Z-brackets, all included in the SGM-5K5E kit.
Plug-and-play alternative, one BLUETTI cart: Apex 300 (3,840 W, 120/240 V) + B300K expansion battery (5,529.6 Wh total) + 2× SP200L 200 W panels.

carts.bundle_sku: SGM-5K5E at $2,831. The inverter ($530) and battery ($981) bought separately already come to $1,511. That leaves $1,320 in the kit price for six panels, breakers and cables. If the $315 panel price is for one panel, six panels cost $1,890 and buying separately comes to at least $3,401, so the kit SKU would be the cheaper choice. I could not open the panel page to confirm the pack size (HTTP 429).

items: BLUETTI Apex 300 + B300K (3,840 W, 5,529.6 Wh LiFePO4) | https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-b300k | $2,599 (compare-at $2,799) | 2026-11-13

carts.bundle_sku: 'Apex 300+B300K+2*200W' at https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-b300k-2-200w-1 costs $3,499 (compare-at $3,499, so no discount shown). That is MORE than the $3,397 for the separate items, so don't use this bundle. Use the two separate items in one cart.

findings.label: Bundle SKU price vs same items bought separately
findings.value: $3,499 bundle vs $3,397 separate ($102 more for the bundle)

The 2*200W variant of the SP200L page is $798. $2,599 + $798 = $3,397. The bundle page doesn't name its panel model, so I'm assuming its '200W' panels are SP200L.
